headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: The 174 United flights in the air are 73% fewer than usual for this time of day; over the past 7 days, the median at this hour was 651.

The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into San Francisco until 11:59 PM PT, because of wind; delays average 138 minutes, up to 690 minutes. The FAA also has a ground stop for flights into Toronto (YYZ) until 6:15 PM ET, which rates the chance of an extension as high, and ground delay programs for flights into Boston until 9:59 PM ET and New York LaGuardia until 10:59 PM ET.

Los Angeles (LAX) is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting so far today, with 73% of departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (52 departed). San Francisco has 3 confirmed cancellations among its 323 departures today.

Newark (EWR) has weather affecting operations: somewhat low clouds or visibility and rain, which can cause minor delays. The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark until 10:00 PM ET; it is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, and do the same for Toronto, Boston and New York LaGuardia.
